styleLock.backgroundSystem: three locked fields and nothing else: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the on-body packshot and the variant row, pale mist-grey #EFF1F4 for the callout, detail grid and trust screens, and one coastal field of sand #DCC7A8, sea #6E9CB4 and sky #A9C7DC for the two outdoor screens; the single macro screen uses the garment own surface #17181B
styleLock.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced studio key at 5600K from the front-left with a white bounce on the shadow side, low contrast, matte fabric read with no hard specular, one honest soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment; outdoor screens keep hard high sun from the upper left or upper right at 5800-6000K with a matching single shadow direction
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white painted cyclorama #FFFFFF, matte pale grey board #EFF1F4 for laid and folded screens, bare sand #DCC7A8 outdoors; no wood, no marble, no glossy acrylic plinth
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family only, medium weight for headline lines in deep charcoal #2E3238, small letterspaced caps for micro labels, thin single-weight leader rules as the whole label system; no serif, no script, no retro or cartoon faces
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin line glyphs in deep charcoal #2E3238 inside square outlined frames on the pale field #EFF1F4, one abstract glyph per frame, identical stroke weight and frame size, label slots left empty; never a seal, ribbon, award or certification pictogram
styleLock.presentationRules: two locked scales only: the worn view cropped from the jaw down so no face ever enters frame, and the close crop on hands, collar, cuff and fabric; garment scale, hem position and closure line stay identical between screens; every panel of a multi-panel screen reuses the exact same light and crop; pocket, seam and hardware placement is always read from the reference and never redrawn
noDrift: no visible model face or identifiable person
no invented ratings, measurements, percentages or seals
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean active womens outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, pale mist-grey #EFF1F4, coastal sky blue #A9C7DC and one warm sun gold accent #E8A33D; daylight-balanced studio key at 5600K from the front-left with white bounce fill, low contrast, matte fabric read and one honest soft contact shadow grounding the garment, outdoor screens on hard high sun with a single matching shadow direction; one modern geometric sans-serif family in deep charcoal #2E3238 with thin single-weight leader rules as the label system; single-weight thin line glyphs inside square outlined frames with empty label slots; worn view cropped from the jaw down plus close crops on hands, collar, cuff and fabric as the only product scales; stable garment scale and hem position; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 一、逐图事实：001 纯白场模特正面上身，立领与前中拉链闭合、一侧手插入腰侧口袋、画面自鼻尖以下裁切；002 同一件纯白场背面上身，自颈下裁切，可见后片整面织纹与拼缝；003 海滨沙滩场景，模特抬手遮阳、面部完整入镜，画面左上有弧形屏蔽罩与四枚折线箭头图形，左下叠一枚金色齿轮边圆形印章并带等级字样；004 白场右侧三条水平引线，分别指向领口、腰身与下摆，配三行英文卖点原句；005 上下两联特写，上为手插拉链侧袋、下为把一部带摄像模组的手机放入内袋，两联底部各一条深色题注带英文原句；006 深色织纹面料对折微距，底部一条灰蓝色带内排四枚线性图标并各配一行英文标签；007 上下两联特写，上为立领与拉链头、下为袖口指套孔开口，两联底部各一条题注带英文原句；008 深色织纹面料与拉链齿的斜向微距，白场一角虚化。二、品类判定依据：主体为成年女式立领拉链外套，肩斜、胸围与袖长比例、收腰剪裁与指套袖口均指向女装外穿夹克，非贴身或睡衣类，故取 L1 女装 / L2 外套，leaf 记为女士立领拉链薄款运动外套，与给定的女装/外套提示一致，未改判；因是无电加热、非工具类服饰，不落 运动户外 而落 女装。三、分镜取舍：001 与 002 拆成白底正面主图与背身场景两个不同任务；003 一图承担两镜，取其图形屏蔽结构做卖点主张屏、取其海滨环境做背身场景；005 与 007 同为两联题注细节，合并为一屏四格细节网格；006 与 008 同为深色织纹微距，合并为一镜微距，并把 006 的图标带改造成收口屏的空白证明位；全套八镜按 点击-利益-结构-代入-选色-做工-材质-信任 排序。四、已剥离内容：原品牌字与系列名、店铺与平台字样、水印、模特身份与面容（含 001 鼻尖以下与 003 完整面部，全部改写为颈下或下颌以下裁切并显式禁止露脸）、全部英文文案原句（面料、拉伸、干燥、领型、袖口等表述）、防护等级字样与圆形印章图形、星级与平台徽章角标、手机品牌与摄像模组细节、题注带与图标标签文字，以上一律改写为 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 或空印章框、空图标框、空标签位这类空白证明位；色卡一镜只做颜色并列结构，具体颜色由生成时按产品数据锁定，未虚构任何颜色名称、防护等级、克重、成分百分比或检测数据。
